label: Basic
description: Basic pagination. Best for the stock pattern: labelled Previous and Next around 3 page buttons, with page 2 outlined as current.

label: No Labels
description: Pagination without labels. Best for chevron only arrows, named for screen readers, around 3 numbers with page 2 current.

label: Hover Border
description: Pagination with borderless pages. Best for labelled arrows around 3 pages whose idle numbers have no border, like a toolbar.

label: Circle Buttons
description: Pagination with round buttons. Best for fully round page buttons, with page 2 outlined as current.

label: Compact Go-To
description: Compact pagination with go-to-page. Best for chevrons, the first pages and an ellipsis above a small Go to page number field.

label: In Card
description: Numbered pagination on a card. Best for a padded card holding round chevrons, pages 1 to 3, an ellipsis, then the last pages, with the current page filled.

label: Arrow Links
description: Arrow-only pagination. Best for two arrow buttons pushed to opposite ends of a row, and no page numbers at all.

label: Centered Page Info
description: Pagination with centred page info. Best for chevron arrows at both ends with a centred Page 1 of 10 between them.

label: Left Page Info
description: Pagination with page info first. Best for a Page 1 of 10 count at the start, with the arrows grouped at the end.

label: Trailing Ellipsis
description: Pagination with a trailing ellipsis. Best for labelled arrows around the first pages and a trailing ellipsis, with no last page after it.

label: Outline Strip
description: Joined page strip. Best for one bordered strip of joined square cells split by rules, with a muted fill on the current page.

label: Rows Per Page
description: Rows per page with range info. Best for a footer with no page numbers: a rows per page select, and a 1–25 of 100 range with first, previous, next and last buttons.

label: Page Select
description: Page select with first and last jumps. Best for a Page 1 to Page 10 select beside first, previous, next and last icon buttons.

label: Full Width Go-To
description: Numbered pagination with go-to-page. Best for chevrons and the pages near the current one above a page number field at the end.

label: Info & Per-Page
description: Page info, pages and per-page select. Best for a 3 part footer: a Page 1 of 10 count, arrows around the first pages, and a per page select.
